title: Volcanoes of Africa
intro: 10 volcanoes of Africa, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Gufa Volcano
rounds.fact: Gufa Volcano is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 600 m in the source data. The data places it in Eritrea.
